grounding.states: a dark, quiet room helps a child nap
the same short wind-down routine before each nap
catching tired cues early keeps a child from getting overtired

value.answer: Depends a bit on his age, but a few things work at almost any age: a dark, quiet room, the same short wind-down every time (a book, a song, a cuddle), and putting him down when he first shows he's tired, since an overtired kid often fights sleep harder. How old is he?
